lede: Baltimore Ravens carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#6 in EPA per play), while Cleveland Browns owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#7 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Cleveland Browns +5.0 with a fair total of 41.2 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Cleveland Browns run offence vs Baltimore Ravens run defence, which sits −0.165 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
